tasks.sentence: Create a new image that is 640 pixels wide and 360 pixels high, write the word Harbor on it, and save it as harbor-banner.png in the Pictures folder.
Open Drawing's Preferences and turn off the option "Use 'Ctrl' to zoom".
Rotate the open picture 90 degrees clockwise (to the right) and save it.
Scale the open picture to 400 pixels wide and 300 pixels high and save it.
In Drawing, turn on "Show tools names" so the tool list shows text labels.
Write the word Harbor on the open picture with the text tool, then save the picture.
In the gitg window, switch the repository to the existing branch release-2026-11 (check it out).
Commit only the change to README.md, using the commit message: Update usage notes for November

Commit src/util.py and the new file docs/CHANGELOG.md together (leave README.md uncommitted) with the message "Add changelog and subtract helper", then create a branch named release-2026-12 at that new commit.
Create a new branch named tide-notes that starts at the newest commit of main, "Use util in main".
In gitg, stage the modified file README.md without committing, and leave src/util.py unstaged.
Create a tag named v2026.11 on the commit whose subject is "Document usage".
Add an all-day event titled Harbor Inspection on 2026-11-12.
Delete the event "Dock Safety Meeting" on 2026-11-18.
Add an all-day event titled Customs Visit on 2026-11-24 with the location Pier 9.
Create an event titled Tide Briefing on 2026-11-12 from 10:00 to 11:00 in the location Harbor Office.
Add an all-day event Crew Dinner on 2026-11-26 and an all-day event Crew Breakfast on 2026-11-27.
In GNOME Calendar, switch the view from Month to Week.
Create a new contact named Harbor Clerk with the email address clerk@harbor.example.
Create a new contact named Marina Office.
Create a new contact named Dock Master with the phone number 555-0142.
Create a new contact named Pier Agent with the phone number 555-0177 and the email address agent@pier.example.
In GNOME Contacts, open the main menu and sort the contact list by surname.
Create a new contact named Quay Manager with the phone number 555-0188 labelled Work and the email address quay@harbor.example.
Add a new entry with the title Harbor Wifi and the username dock-admin.
Edit the existing entry Dock Server and set its URL to https://dock.example.net (keep its other fields).
Delete the entry named Old Router from the database (the other entries stay).
Open KeePassXC's application settings, turn on "Backup database file before saving", and confirm with OK.
Create a group named Berths, then add an entry inside that group with the title Slip 14, the username berth-14 and the password Tide!2026-Slip.
Create a new group named Marina Logins in the database.
Add a locally installed game named Tide Quest that uses the Linux runner.
Add the game "Keep Game" to the favorites (leave "Old Game" alone).
In Lutris, hide the side panel (the library sidebar on the left).
Open Lutris Preferences and turn on "Hide text under icons".
Remove the game "Old Game" from the Lutris library and keep "Keep Game".
Add a locally installed game named Harbor Run with the Wine runner and the release year 2019, then add it to the favorites.
Open the note Welcome and add a new last line: Visit the harbor office on 2026-11-20.
Create a folder named Logs, create a note named Tide log inside that folder, and write two lines in it: Low tide at 06:40 and, on the next line, High tide at 19:05
Create a new folder named Logs in the vault.
Rename the note Projects to Harbor Projects.
Create a new note named Tide log and write the line: Low tide at 06:40
In the note Projects, tick the unticked task "write report".
In Okular, add a bookmark to the page that is currently shown.
Add a bookmark to page 2 and another bookmark to page 3 of the document.
Switch Okular's view mode to Facing Pages and set the zoom level to 200%.
In Okular, go to page 3 of the open PDF.
On page 3, add a Pop-up Note with the text Verify totals and bookmark that page; then switch the view mode to Facing Pages.
On page 2, add a Pop-up Note whose text is: Check Q3 figures
